title: Metric toolbar: keyboard navigation & translation fallback prototype
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create and validate a compact metric toolbar pattern used on Dashboards and Cost Explorer that: supports full keyboard traversal (single-tab access to toolbar, arrow key movement between controls, Enter/Space activation), exposes accessible labels for translated metric names, and gracefully falls back to locale-aware short labels when translations are missing. Prototype should demonstrate color token contrast adjustments per locale (e.g., high-contrast for DE and JP personas) and variable-width text handling without breaking layout or focus ring. Work covers design spec, Figma prototype, and evaluation criteria for dev handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Toolbar receives a single tab stop from the page and subsequent arrow keys traverse controls in logical order
All interactive controls have accessible names via aria-label or visible label; translation fallback strategy applied when i18n key missing
Contrast ratio for primary controls >= 4.5:1 against background in normal text sizes; tokens for high-contrast theme produce >=7:1 where dense text is used
When translated labels exceed width, UI collapses to icon + tooltip pattern without removing keyboard focus or label announcement
Figma prototype with keyboard-focus states and localized variants for en-US, de-DE, ja-JP shared with engineering and accessibility reviewers
Small-a11y smoke test (VoiceOver and NVDA) passes for navigation and label announcement across locales
design_notes: Introduce a single "aria-toolbar" role for the container to help screen readers announce the group
Use arrow-key focus management that updates tabindex dynamically rather than relying on DOM order reflow
Define a translation fallback priority: full label -> short label -> English label -> key id (last resort). Document mapping in i18n files
Color tokens should reference console theme tokens (token-primary, token-surface) with a modifier for locale contrast where we apply a contrast boost variable
Avoid truncation that hides semantic suffixes like currency units. Prefer icon+tooltip for overflow to keep meanings intact
Provide microcopy for collapsed state to explain the icon-only affordance to first-time localized users
prototypes: Figma frames: Toolbar / en-US / de-DE / ja-JP / collapsed-icon-mode
links: GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4812 (WIP: focus manager & CSS tokens)
comments: 2026-02-11 - Aisha Patel: Initial prototype uploaded to Figma. Asking ENG for feedback on focus-manager API surface. Added localization fallback proposal.

2026-02-18 - Linnea Wu: Reviewed prototype, noted that aria-toolbar may be noisy for some screen readers; suggested experimenting with aria-roledescription and announcing item count instead of role. Added notes about numeric formatting in ja-JP.

2026-02-22 - Erik Johnson (ENG): ENG-49502 linked. Implemented a focusManager hook draft in feature branch. Concern: dynamic tabindex changes could break virtualized lists; proposed using roving tabindex pattern with attribute data-focus-order.

2026-02-28 - Accessibility team (Jules Martin): Performed early NVDA pass. Keyboard traversal works but tooltip dismissal is inconsistent when moving focus quickly. Recommend longer tooltip persistence for keyboard users and explicit aria-describedby association.

2026-03-05 - Linnea Wu: Updated prototype to include collapsed icon tooltip variant and added the English->short label fallback mapping. Ran contrast checks using Axe and manual calculations; adjusted token-high-contrast mapping.

2026-03-08 - UX Research (Marta Gomez): Quick moderated sessions with 5 participants using non-English locales. Participants expected currency/units to remain visible; collapsed icon mode confused 2/5 without microcopy. Recommendation: expose unit in tooltip and add first-use banner for new toolbar behavior.

2026-03-10 - Aisha Patel: Preparing handoff docs and acceptance criteria. Marked ticket In Review. Noted remaining work: ENG to address tooltip dismissal timing and finalize focus-manager contract. PR #4812 assigned to ENG-49502 for integration.
decisions: Adopt roving tabindex pattern implemented via data-focus-order and a small focus-manager hook to avoid full DOM reflow
Translation fallback priority locked: full -> short -> en-US -> id-key. Documented in i18n spec.
Use token-high-contrast with locale modifier; accessibility will validate per-release for DE/JP themes
Collapse-to-icon behavior chosen for labels exceeding 28ch; collapsed state must keep visible tooltip and aria-describedby reference
